PhotoPrism. Provides the verified managed photo application under a same-origin Caddy path.
Browser. Hosts the installed or web PWA and enforces browser-origin boundaries.
a.text: Hosts the installed or web PWA and

a.xlink:title: React / Vite PWA. Renders Lite screens and sends same-origin requests only to FastAPI through Caddy.
FastAPI /api/lite/*. Validates requests, owns safe read APIs, admits commands, and never delegates browser execution directly to NATS or shell.
Remote-access readiness checks. Combines tailscaled state, Tailnet IPv4, NATS listener reachability, agent/supervisor status, and safe guidance.
GitHub Release. Publishes the verified Lite release manifest, checksums, and dist.zip assets for the release subprocess.
Lite node agent. Connects to NATS, publishes heartbeat/telemetry/health, handles device commands, and reconnects after outages.
NATS / JetStream. Provides the command and event backbone with durable delivery; it is never contacted directly by the frontend.
a.text: is never contacted directly by the...

a.xlink:title: tailscaled daemon. Owns Tailscale networking; startup scripts may detect/start it safely while read APIs remain side-effect-free.
Caddy same-origin proxy. Serves the PWA and routes /api/lite/* and managed app paths without exposing backend secrets.
Primary and secondary NATS listeners. Exposes local and verified Tailnet-reachable NATS listeners for agents without hardcoding credentials or addresses.
Local LAN. Provides local-device access to the same-origin Caddy endpoint without hardcoded addresses.
Tailscale remote access. Provides private Tailnet connectivity and HTTPS identity without becoming a browser-held secret or control owner.
